dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Symptomatic chorea (secondary choreoathetosis) due to left thalamic tuberculoma

Alternatives:
1. Thalamic dystonia due to the same left thalamic lesion (the writhing/twisting component may represent dystonia rather than pure chorea)
2. Autoimmune chorea (e.g., anti-NMDA receptor or other antibody-mediated) triggered by tuberculous infection — would warrant CSF autoimmune antibody panel
3. Functional (psychogenic) movement disorder superimposed on a structural lesion — the discordance between progressive worsening of movements and radiological improvement warrants consideration
